answer: Problem: disposable keys flood peer panels until honest jade stake is diluted. Mechanism: each new identity must post a mirror bond H(pubkey||epoch||panel_seed) and wait until a rotating beacon committee of seven re-signs the same challenge digest after a forty-minute cool-down. Cost: a failed re-sign burns half the bond and locks that key out of grading for four epochs. Verification: peers recompute the bond against the public panel seed and reject duplicate operator clusters. Failure: a bribed beacon or reused cool-down proofs zero the answer weight.
